function: Soft actor-critic learns real-time positions of pinching antennas to maximize covert rate for Bob in sensing-aided covert communication; beamforming, AN and EKF tracking are non-learned (p. 7-8).
system: PASS transmitter with Nt=3 waveguides, Mt=4 PAs each, single-antenna Bob and Willie, 3 leaky coaxial cables for echo sensing; 15 GHz, 30 dBm; no RIS (p. 3, 10).
method: Soft actor-critic reinforcement learning (two critics, entropy regularization), trained online; state: positions of Bob, estimated Willie, PAs; action: initial PA positions; reward: covert rate (p. 8).
data_channel: No dataset: line-of-sight free-space PASS channels simulated from geometry, Willie on a random trajectory from a kinematic model, Bob fixed (p. 3, 8, 10-11).
test_conditions: Online learning and evaluation along the same simulated Willie trajectory (about 20,000 CPIs), 20 Monte Carlo runs; transmit power swept 0 to 40 dBm (p. 11).
baselines: Non-learned: PASS 1D exhaustive search, PASS greedy placement at Bob's x-coordinate, fixed full-digital MIMO with perfect CSI; no learned baseline such as DDPG or PPO (p. 10).
metrics: Average covert rate (bps/Hz) and its CDF; EKF position and velocity tracking MSE; covert rate versus transmit power (p. 10-11).
complexity: none for the proposed method; only qualitative claims of low complexity (p. 2, 11); O(K Nt^3.5) is quoted for the SDR alternative, not for the proposed method (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 8: "as the channels are LoS and parameterized by the positions of Willie, Bob, and PAs"; a custom free-space model (Eqs. 4, 9), with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "the proposed DRL-based algorithm gradually learns to tune the position of PAs" along one trajectory; the only variation is a transmit-power sweep (Fig. 8), which does not count.
q3_support: p. 10: "This baseline replaces the SAC approach with an exhaustive 1D search for the PA position"; the greedy and perfect-CSI MIMO baselines are also non-learned, and no earlier learned method is compared (DQN, DDPG, PPO only named on p. 8).
q4_support: p. 11: "the computational complexity of EKF for PASS is moderate" is qualitative; p. 10 says the 1D search has running time comparable to SAC, with no numbers. No order, FLOPs or runtime of the proposed method.
q5_support: p. 10: "For the basic parameters, the carrier frequency is set to 15 GHz [33]" describes a custom simulation; no code or data link and no public dataset appear in the 13 pages.
notes: Preprint is arXiv 2509.06170v1 (7 Sep 2025). Included on the reading that the learned element is the SAC agent setting PA positions (beam configuration) in an ISAC system, while beamforming, AN design and EKF tracking are closed-form or classical. Area 5 by the specificity order; area 3 is the alternative if the learned part is judged to serve communication only. If PA positioning is judged antenna hardware design, the exclusion reason would be function. PASS is not a RIS, so ris is 0.
